description: The message is a printf-style template; any trailing arguments are substituted into it before it reaches a backend. Supports string and integer placeholders, multiple placeholders, and templates with no placeholders (emitted verbatim).

cases.expected_output:
event=deprecation_notice
backend=trigger_error
message=this is deprecated foo 1234
package=acme/orm
link=https://dep.example.com/orm/1234
unique_count=1
count[https://dep.example.com/orm/1234]=1

event=deprecation_notice
backend=trigger_error
message=use newApi instead
package=acme/orm
link=https://dep.example.com/orm/1234
unique_count=1
count[https://dep.example.com/orm/1234]=1

event=deprecation_notice
backend=trigger_error
message=plain message without placeholders
package=acme/orm
link=https://dep.example.com/orm/1234
unique_count=1
count[https://dep.example.com/orm/1234]=1
